source_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: source plate for an Unreal Engine Niagara 4x4 SubUV sprite atlas
Primary request: Create one square 4-by-4 contact sheet containing sixteen separate photoreal whitewater sprite studies, each centered in its own invisible cell against an absolute pure black (#000000) background.
Subject order, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom: cells 0-5 are six distinct ballistic river spray plumes with torn sheets, aerated foam fragments, and fine microdroplets; cells 6-10 are five distinct clusters of suspended water beads and short droplet trails; cells 11-13 are three soft aerated river-mist puffs with porous natural density; cells 14-15 are two dense turbulent rapid-aerosol/foam volumes with lace-like breakup.
Style/medium: high-speed macro photography of real cold freshwater whitewater, physically plausible droplet scale, varied organic silhouette, detailed thin foam membranes, crisp beads plus soft aerosol, neutral grayscale/white water only.
Composition/framing: exact square canvas; regular 4x4 layout; every phenomenon fully contained within its cell with at least 15 percent black padding on every cell edge; no overlap between cells; no visible grid, dividers, labels, text, or borders.
Lighting/mood: neutral directional daylight response with convincing translucent water and bright aeration, no colored lighting.
Constraints: background must be uniform pure black across the entire image; isolate only the airborne water/foam; keep all cell boundaries black for bilinear sampling; each of the sixteen silhouettes must be visibly different and direction-neutral enough for billboard rotation; no watermark.
Avoid: river surface, landscape, rocks, raft, people, sky, horizon, reflections on a floor, smoke, clouds, fire, snow, paint splatter, cotton-like blobs, repeated silhouettes, rectangular sprite edges, grid lines, labels, text, watermark.
usage: Review-only presentation atlas; solver/contact state remains the sole emission authority.
